steps.name: install-dagger-core-fix-copy-metadata-and-focused-gate
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 4b805fd1780c42e7c7ca900ccf7fc3e0801b4b17; test -f build/climate_v6_full_seed1847_vpd.npz; test -f reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.npz; test -f reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.json; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage10/climate_dagger.py > tools/ml/climate_dagger.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage10/run_dagger_overnight.py > tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage10/test_climate_dagger.py > tests/test_climate_dagger.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''def _copy_model(src_weights: Path, src_metadata: Path, dst_weights: Path, dst_metadata: Path) -> None:
    dst_weights.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src_weights, dst_weights)
    shutil.copy2(src_metadata, dst_metadata)
'''
new='''def _copy_model(src_weights: Path, src_metadata: Path, dst_weights: Path, dst_metadata: Path) -> None:
    dst_weights.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src_weights, dst_weights)
    payload = json.loads(src_metadata.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    payload["weights_file"] = dst_weights.name
    dst_metadata.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('copy-model block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_dagger.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_training_weighted.py -q; git diff --check

steps.name: dagger-final-held-out-evaluation
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py final; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_dagger_overnight.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['completed_iterations'] == 5
assert len(d['iterations']) == 5
assert d['final']['dataset_rows'] == 97200
assert d['final']['validation_rows'] == 1200
assert d['final']['test_rows'] == 1200
assert d['final']['scenario_overlap_count'] == 0
assert d['final']['closed_loop']['config']['seed'] == 271828
assert d['final']['closed_loop']['config']['workers'] == 6
assert len(d['final']['closed_loop']['families']) == 15
print('STAGE10_FINAL_REPORT_GATE=PASS verdict=' + ('PASS' if d['final']['closed_loop']['verdict']['accepted'] else 'NO_GO'))
PY
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage10
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py reports/ml/climate_v6_dagger_overnight.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.npz reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.json; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py reports/ml/climate_v6_dagger_overnight.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.npz reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.json; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Run overnight climate DAgger experiment'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
